steps.title: Arm Raise
steps.instruction: Slowly raise both arms out to the side until they are about shoulder height. Hold steady.

steps.title: Sit to Stand
steps.instruction: From a seated position, stand up fully, then sit back down. Repeat at your own pace.

steps.title: Balance Hold
steps.instruction: Stand comfortably with both feet on the floor. Keep your hips level and stay as still as you can.
